scalars.scalar_value: Two years recent outpatient medical clinic clerical experience

items.item_text: Two years recent outpatient medical clinic clerical experience

Working knowledge of Google Workspace, medical terminology, CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS, MS4 and patient scheduling experience (If no internal qualified candidates apply, may waive minimum requirements based on operational needs)
Performs all aspects of chart maintenance which includes pulling and preparing charts for the following day and setting up new files as needed

Schedules patient appointments which includes initial, recheck and pre-ops. Updates schedule changes and performs necessary rescheduling of patients and prints and distributes daily clinic schedule. Provides clerical support for outgoing and incoming referrals for patients as requested.
Maintains medical records which includes requesting records as needed, filing and retrieving records, documents and correspondence in a timely manner
Contacts and reschedules clients that have not shown up for their appointment via phone or letter, and gives chart to the Practitioner for follow up review
Answers telephones which includes routing incoming calls, as appropriate, and documenting accurately telephone messages

Completes daily charge sheets using CDM/CPT-HCPCS crosswalk and verifying completion of charge sheets against charge posting daily report which includes obtaining necessary information from practitioners to accurately complete daily charge sheets
Working knowledge of clinic based patient care programs
